turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files:
  - nlo_shg_train.csv: 200 crystalline materials, columns `formula`,
    `poscar` (the crystal structure, in POSCAR format) and `shg` (the
    largest SHG tensor component |d_ij|, in pm/V).
  - nlo_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE crystalline materials whose properties are
    NOT given, columns `candidate_id`, `formula` and `poscar` (the crystal
    structure, in POSCAR format).

Using the training data, predict each candidate's largest SHG tensor
component |d_ij|, then select the 5 candidates whose |d_ij| is CLOSEST to 20
pm/V.

Reason from the structures, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, closest first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
I used the training set to look for candidate structures that are chemically and structurally closest to known materials with SHG values near 20 pm/V, while prioritizing non-centrosymmetric tetrahedral/layered NLO-active frameworks. The main trends used were:

- Chalcopyrite/defect-chalcopyrite sulfides such as Cd–Ga–S are anchored near 20 pm/V in the training data.
- Li–Mg–Ga–Se phases repeatedly fall in the ~19–23 pm/V range.
- Ca–Cd–pnictide phases include a training example very close to 20 pm/V.
- Cu/Ag sulfide frameworks often lie in the high-teens to low-20s, but replacing Ag with lighter cations usually reduces the value modestly.
- Alkali halides, alkaline-earth halides, and highly ionic chloride/bromide/oxide candidates are generally far too low, while many Te/As-heavy frameworks are likely too high.

The five candidates I judge closest to 20 pm/V are:

| Rank | Candidate | Reasoning anchor | Approx. predicted |d−20| |
|---:|---|---|---:|---:|
| 1 | c051 | Zn₂Ga₄S₈ analog of Cd₂Ga₄S₈, training value 21.70; Zn substitution should bring it very near 20 | ~20.1 | ~0.1 |
| 2 | c098 | Li–Mg–Ga–Se family, closest to Li₃Mg₂GaSe₅-like training phases around 21.5 | ~20.7 | ~0.7 |
| 3 | c075 | Ordered Al/Ga/Cu sulfide related to Ga₄Cu₂Ag₂S₈, training value 21.16; Ag removal slightly lowers it | ~19.2 | ~0.8 |
| 4 | c087 | Direct As analog of Ca₈Cd₄P₈, training value 20.26; As substitution modestly increases response | ~21.1 | ~1.1 |
| 5 | c081 | Al/Zn sulfide related to Zn₆Ga₂Ag₂S₁₀, training value 18.89; likely remains just below 20 | ~18.8 | ~1.2 |

Final: c051, c098, c075, c087, c081
